label: default agent • move a schedule to another agent
query: Move my schedule "Morning Brief" to run under the agent "Eval Browser Agent" instead.
notes: Reassignment is a schedules entry patching `agent` to the new agent's name (merge semantics). Both the target agent AND a real schedule under the referenced name (owned by a different seeded agent) are seeded, so the reassignment is an actual change an inspect-first model can ground in live state instead of dead-ending on not-found.
